fact: Commission on Administrative Justice chair says the Commission, with the Ministry of Public Service, is developing an app, to be launched as the PASHA Ombudsman platform, for the public to file complaints about public-sector service.

The Commission on Administrative Justice launched the public portal of its Complaints Management Information System on 24 May 2022, said it had used the system fully for complaint handling since 1 April 2022, held over 6,000 active complaints and had processed over 493 through it.
The Commission chair said complainants can lodge complaints against public entities through CMIS from anywhere in the country.
